name: Alpha and premultiplication check
summary: Verify alpha interpretation so composited layers do not show dark or bright fringing.
mediaPrerequisites: a layer carrying an alpha channel
qualityChecks: no dark fringe on light backgrounds
no bright fringe on dark backgrounds
edges hold up at the strongest intended opacity
failureModes: treating straight alpha as premultiplied or the reverse
fringing visible only against certain backgrounds and missed in review

provenance.claim: blend modes determine how a layer combines with what is beneath it

validation.notes: Becomes load-bearing as soon as any overlay or masked treatment ships.
